blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. The fastest way to describe a warehouse is with there is and there are.

You say "There are three trucks. There is one pallet missing." That is one sentence, and everyone knows the situation.

Use "is" for one thing and "are" for many things. Clear numbers help the team. When the numbers are clear, nobody makes a wrong decision.

items.q: What is the fastest way to describe a warehouse?
items.why: "The fastest way to describe a warehouse is with there is and there are."

items.q: When do you use "is"?
items.why: "Use is for one thing and are for many things."

items.q: "There are three trucks." How many trucks?
items.why: "There are three trucks" = três caminhões.

items.q: The text suggests that clear numbers help the team because…
items.why: Inferência: "When the numbers are clear, nobody makes a wrong decision."

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: short, clear sentences are good at work
items.why: Inferência: o texto elogia a frase curta e clara com there is / there are.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James no armazém. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Good morning, everyone. It is eight o'clock, and I am walking through the warehouse for the daily report. Let me count the trucks and the drivers.

There are two trucks at the gate. One truck is full, and one truck is empty. There are three drivers here today. Two drivers are in the queue, and one driver is having a coffee. That is fine. He can start soon.

Now, there is a small problem. There is one pallet missing from truck number one. There are five bags on the floor, not on the pallet. I will put the bags back now. It is quick.

There is also a short delay on route two. The traffic is bad this morning, so the load is late. But it is not a big problem. The truck is only ten minutes late.

So, to be clear: there are two trucks, there are three drivers, there is one pallet missing, and there is one small delay. The fleet is ready. We can start. Have a good day, and drive safe.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How many trucks are at the gate?
items.why: "There are two trucks at the gate."

items.q: What is the problem with truck number one?
items.why: "There is one pallet missing from truck number one."

items.q: Why is the load on route two late?
items.why: "The traffic is bad this morning, so the load is late."

items.q: James says the delay is "not a big problem." This suggests that…
options: the small delay is okay to accept
items.why: Inferência: dez minutos de atraso é pequeno, então James segue tranquilo.

items.q: How does James feel about starting the day?
items.why: Inferência: "The fleet is ready. We can start." — tom calmo e organizado.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The truck is waiting at the gate." A gate is…
items.why: Gate = portão, a entrada do armazém.

items.q: "There are ten boxes on one pallet." A pallet is…
items.why: Pallet = palete, a base onde se empilham as caixas.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The truck is full. It has a heavy ___ today."
items.why: Load = carga, o que o caminhão transporta.

items.q: "A car and a truck are both a vehicle." A vehicle is…
items.why: Vehicle = veículo, como carro ou caminhão.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We have twenty trucks. It is a big ___."
items.why: Fleet = frota, o conjunto de todos os veículos.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no armazém. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The boss has to sign off on the report." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "We will roll out the new trucks next week." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = colocar em uso, lançar.

items.q: "The driver is late. We need to speed up." To speed up means to…
items.why: Speed up = acelerar, ir mais rápido.

items.q: "Please check on the drivers in the queue." To check on means to…
items.why: Check on = verificar como algo ou alguém está.

items.q: "The trucks are ready. We can set off now." To set off means to…
items.why: Set off = partir, começar a viagem.
